overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the council did not deliberate when a quorum recorded a holiday greeting after the November 30, 2023 meeting, and the complaint was closed as resolved.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the council deliberated outside a posted meeting on or about Nov 30, 2023, when a quorum recorded a holiday greeting after the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the available evidence in this case, including video recordings and the Council’s representations, we do not find that deliberation took place when Council members recorded a holiday greeting following adjournment of the November 30 meeting.
